ValidationRule.description: The Actual Amount Offered must be less than the Actual Amount Collected, else the rule will fire
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c > ACTUAL_AMT_COLLECTED__c, ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Funded"), OR( RecordType.Name = 'Working Capital Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA', RecordType.Name = 'FRPSA' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Actual Amount Offered cannot be more than the Actual Amount Collected
